_doc.about: Extra morals for Shadowra. Add a new entry to 'morals' and restart the game – no code needed. The game copies these definitions into the database table 'moral_defs' (saves/shadowra.db) and stores Shadowra's value of each moral per save in 'moral_values'.
_doc.key: unique id, lowercase letters/digits/underscore, never change it after release (saves use it)
_doc.name: shown name per language: {"de": ..., "en": ...}
_doc.description: what it means / does, per language
_doc.level: 'basic' or 'advanced'. Advanced morals are hard-limited by the game to at most 3 points (FSK 12 version), whatever 'max' says.
_doc.ages: at which ages it can be gained: any of 'hatchling', 'juvenile', 'adult'
_doc.gain: which game events raise it and by how much, e.g. {"cozy_meal": 1}. Events: see 'events' below.
_doc.effects: list of bonuses/penalties unlocked when the value reaches 'at': {"at": 3, "good": true, "name": {...}, "description": {...}, "mods": {"food_heal": 1.1}}. Mods: see 'mods' below (1.0 = unchanged, 1.1 = +10 %, 0.9 = -10 %; 'flee' is added in pixels).
_doc.limit_line: optional: what Shadowra says to the player (walking up to the camera) when an event would raise the moral past its max. Without it, she just stops gaining.

events.cozy_meal: eating at an altar curled up around the food at her side
events.rest: eating or sleeping at a nest / altar
events.kindness: kind deeds: talking to Morwen, sparing Mafor, hugs that are accepted
events.affection: hugs and cozy meals that bring her closer to others
events.hunt_ground: killing / drinking from creatures on the ground
events.greed: drinking blood while she has plenty of mana
events.overflow: drinking with full mana, devouring Mafor's light

mods.stam_cost: stamina cost of running, flying, dashing
mods.veil_drain: mana burned by the Shadow Veil in light
mods.flee: how early peaceful creatures flee (pixels, added)
